senses.gloss: to be caught, seized. Ib. נִלְכְּדָה העיר the city was taken.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 30:16">Ex. R. s. 30</cite> <he>ולבסוף נ׳ בזקנתו וכ׳</he> and finally in his old age he was caught (in the tempter’s net), and began to be afraid &c.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 31:1">Pesik. R. s. 31</cite> <he>אימתי תִּילָּכֵד</he> when will she (Jerusalem) be taken?; a. e.
